symptom: MDL-BUTTON02 refused `$dvP` passed as an action argument (and as a data-source argument) from a widget directly inside dvP, though `exec --no-check` of the same page builds with 0 errors.
cause: The rule's premise was a CE0117 measured on 11.14.0 (mendixlabs/mxcli#1324) when the writer stored the argument as expression text. Since #2095 a bare container variable is stored as Variable {Widget, PageParameter}, which Mendix accepts; the rule kept refusing that shape.
fix: Action and data-source arguments that are exactly `$<nearest container>` are not flagged. Everything stored as expression text still is: `$dvP/Name` arguments, Visible, Editable, DynamicClasses (CE0117), XPath (CE0161).
insight: Separate writer from version before version-gating a rule: one probe page with all ten slots, written by today's binary with --no-check, then mx check on 11.12.6 AND on an 11.14.0 copy made with `mx convert -p` (the version the rule was measured on) gave the same 5-error set, so the change was the writer, not Mendix, and no gate was needed. `mx convert -p <dir>` turns the cached blank 11.12.6 project into any newer cached version in seconds. check now flags exactly mx check's set on the probe.
test: mdl/executor/validate_page_own_container_name_test.go (measured-shape verdicts updated to the 11.12.6/11.14.0 set; the reverted rule fails them), mdl-examples/bug-tests/1324-own-data-container-name*.fail.mdl (still negative, now on the expression form)
